topic.TURISTA.extra 1.006: Four. My father always said there’s always someone who could do with one.
topic.TURISTA.extra 2.label: The camera
topic.TURISTA.extra 2.001: You still take pictures with a camera? Not your phone?
topic.TURISTA.extra 2.002: With my phone I photograph where I parked. With the camera, trips.
topic.TURISTA.extra 2.004: I’ll still look at the trips in ten years. Not the car park.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 1.label: Why are you doing this?
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 1.001: When someone is gone, fragments remain. I wanted them to fit together.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 1.002: They fit together without you cutting off their edges.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 1.003: You say that now. When you’re left with a single recording, you start noticing every bit of hiss.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 1.x01: I’ve worked with hiss all my life. Usually the best part of the recording is hiding under it.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 2.label: What happens after the repair?
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 2.001: Records will show their origin and their versions, and people will be able to disagree. And I’ll make public what I started.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 2.002: Good. Let’s start with those four ports.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 2.x01: That’s what Nina wanted from the beginning. I called it a mess.
topic.VIKTOR.ambient 2.x02: Gran would call it a proper archive.
topic.VIKTOR.after.label: And your mother’s message?
topic.VIKTOR.after.001: I’ve kept that recording whole. Even the moment when she says nothing.
topic.VIKTOR.after.003: I know. Thank you for not trying to repair it.
topic.VIKTOR.after.x01: Four seconds. The longest four seconds I know.
topic.VIKTOR.extra 1.label: Why ordinary days?
topic.VIKTOR.extra 1.001: Because most of a life is made of them. And they’re the first thing to be lost.
topic.VIKTOR.extra 1.002: And that’s why you clean them up?
topic.VIKTOR.extra 1.003: I tidy them. Whatever remains should still be readable in a hundred years.
topic.VIKTOR.extra 1.004: Even if only a fragment remains?
topic.VIKTOR.extra 1.005: Better a readable fragment than a whole that nobody understands.
topic.VIKTOR.extra 2.label: Nina’s warning
topic.VIKTOR.extra 2.001: Why didn’t you listen to Nina back then?
topic.VIKTOR.extra 2.002: I did listen. I just thought she was afraid of something I already knew.
topic.VIKTOR.extra 2.004: I only knew my mother’s voice in the edited version. I thought it was enough for me.
topic.VIKTOR.extra 2.006: Now I know how much of it was missing.
item.READER: A small reader from Tamara. It reads cassettes and service memory, and it doesn’t need a network.
item.READER.purpose: Read the original cassette up in the Atlas pavilion.
item.CATALOG: The public card for collection Z-17, with the years 1962, 1995 and 2020. It won’t get me into the private recordings.
item.CATALOG.purpose: Arrange the service access Nina approved, with Sára.
item.LIFT_TICKET: A ticket for the gondola Biela Púť – Priehyba and the Funitel Priehyba – Chopok, there and back. Valid all day.
item.LIFT_TICKET.purpose: Hold it to the reader at the turnstile and board the cable car.
item.PASS: Nina has approved my diagnostics of the collection. Sára wrote my name down in pen as well.
item.PASS.purpose: Entry to the Atlas service pavilion.
item.FILTER_PHOTO: A phone photo of the panel: DIFFERENCE = DISCARD. I’ve copied the rule into my notes too.
item.FILTER_PHOTO.purpose: Compare the faulty rule with Mira’s original sentence.
item.DIAGNOSTIC: The deleted data are waiting in the buffer until the write is confirmed. If I switch the output to MONITOR, they can be returned.
item.DIAGNOSTIC.purpose: Prepare a safe restore procedure with Nina.
item.LEA_MESSAGE: Lea’s message from 2032, whole and unedited. It survived in the buffer. Nina has allowed it to be played only for Viktor.
item.LEA_MESSAGE.purpose: Play it to Viktor so he hears what the normaliser deleted.
item.PULSE: The trace of Vrbické pleso and its surroundings, saved in the chronometer. I didn’t even touch the ice while measuring.
item.PULSE.purpose: Calculate a safe return from 2035 at the Atlas terminal.
item.PATCH: The procedure KEEP THE EXCEPTIONS, signed by Nina. It returns the withheld data and switches off the write-back.
item.PATCH.purpose: Evidence of return from 2035 for the Return port.
item.DELIVERY_NOTE: Očko’s request: a parcel for the repair shop by the bench with the dog. That description dates from last year.
item.DELIVERY_NOTE.purpose: Find out where the recipient is today.
item.DELIVERY_OK: Tamara has confirmed the parcel is hers, and the new address: the lobby of Hotel Grand Jasná.
quest.M12.goal: Get authorised access to the Atlas buffer and find the faulty rule.
quest.M12.hint.1: Nina is waiting outside Hotel Grand Jasná. The Atlas exhibition is in the hotel and up by the Rotunda.
quest.M12.hint.2: Tamara will lend you a cassette reader, Boris will find the catalogue card using the confirmed handover, and Sára will issue a pass and a ticket against it.
quest.M12.hint.3: Nina outside the hotel → original school cassette on Tamara in the lobby → confirmed handover 2020 on Boris in the exhibition room → catalogue card on Sára at the customer centre → return ticket on the reader at the bottom station → board the Funitel at Priehyba → finish the ride → phone on the normalisation panel by the Rotunda → local audio reader on the service terminal in the Atlas pavilion.
quest.M13.goal: Prepare a safe return and stop any further erasing with the switch.
quest.M13.hint.1: Go to Vrbické pleso. There’s a passive exhibition stand on the path.
quest.M13.hint.2: Capture the trace by the lake with the chronometer and load it into the terminal. Then plug Tóno’s bridge into the Atlas connector on the terrace and switch to MONITOR.
quest.M13.hint.3: Chronometer on the passive stand by Vrbické pleso → reference trace on the service terminal → preserved return bridge on Atlas’s separate connector on the terrace → write switch to MONITOR → the service terminal confirms entry to the chronochamber.
quest.M14.goal: Play Viktor the recording he had cut down himself.
quest.M14.hint.1: Lea’s original message belongs to Viktor. Viktor is in the chronochamber.
quest.M14.hint.2: Words won’t convince Viktor. Play him Lea’s original voice message.
quest.M14.hint.3: Lea’s unaltered voice message → Viktor in the chronochamber. A conversation and Viktor’s consent to the restore follow.
quest.M15.goal: Restore the withheld data and go back to Mira.
quest.M15.hint.1: The four ports are named after the words on the original plate from 1962.
quest.M15.hint.2: Origin is the verified imprint, Voice the school cassette, Consent the confirmed handover and Return the restore procedure.
quest.M15.hint.3: Verified imprint → Origin port, school cassette → Voice port, confirmed handover → Consent port, restore procedure → Return port → on the restore panel assign the years: Origin 1962, Voice 1995, Consent 2020, Return 2035 → confirm the restore.
quest.Q8.goal: Help Očko find a recipient whose address is only a description of a place.
quest.Q8.hint.1: Očko is waiting at Biela Púť with an old description of the address.
quest.Q8.hint.2: Look at the bench with the dog by Vrbické pleso. The note on it tells you where the workshop has moved.
quest.Q8.hint.3: Talk to Očko at the bottom station → the bench with the dog by Vrbické pleso → Očko’s request on Tamara in the lobby → the repair shop’s confirmation on Očko.
quest.Q8.reward: Očko’s thank-you card and the delivered box at the repairer’s desk in the hotel lobby.
puzzle.P04.clue: Each port and each item carries a name and a year. I have the same in my notebook.
puzzle.P04.title: Matching the Four Testimonies
puzzle.P04.wrong: That year doesn’t match this port. The right one is on the item and in my notes.
cutscene.CS01.01.001: Adam, a bit of colour has vanished from that old photo of ours.
cutscene.CS01.01.002: That isn’t colour. Gran, don’t hang up.
cutscene.CS01.02.002: All I wanted was to change a fuse.
cutscene.CS01.03.001: I know this stop. It’s just the year that’s wrong.
cutscene.CS02.01.001: No need to rush any more, Adam. We have time.
cutscene.CS02.02.001: I thought I’d forgotten it. I just hadn’t heard it for a long time.
cutscene.CS03.01.002: I’m off to see a woman who doesn’t know yet that one day she’ll be my gran.
cutscene.CS03.02.001: And I have to make it before her name vanishes from the later records too.
cutscene.CS04.01.001: What doesn’t match, we put side by side. We don’t throw it away.
cutscene.CS04.01.002: One day someone will need to hear that sentence again.
cutscene.CS04.02.001: One object. Many hands. Not one of them is an error in the record.
cutscene.CS05.01.001: Subsequent custodian of the collection: Atlas. Jasná. Year 2035.
cutscene.CS05.01.002: So now I know where the past is going wrong.
cutscene.CS05.02.001: And don’t forget to come back.
cutscene.CS05.02.002: I won’t. This time I’ve written the year of return on the device as well.
cutscene.CS06.01.001: That voice was there all along. I just didn’t want to leave it as it was.
cutscene.CS06.02.001: I cleaned out of the message exactly what I should have kept.
cutscene.CS07.01.001: Buffer data returned. Write-back permanently switched off.
cutscene.CS07.01.002: The names are back. Even the ones that contradict each other.
cutscene.CS07.01.003: At last I see people in it, not a spreadsheet.
cutscene.CS07.02.001: I’ll publish the whole procedure, including the fact that I carried on despite the warning. The originals will be kept separate from the edits.
cutscene.CS07.02.002: And the next change will be approved by the people it affects as well.
cutscene.CS07.03.001: Adam? I can hear you without the echo now.
cutscene.CS07.03.002: Yes. And I’m ringing from the right year.
cutscene.CS07.03.003: You left my shopping exactly where it was supposed to be.
cutscene.CS07.03.004: I saved a bit more than that.
cutscene.CS07.05.001: Not everything needs repairing. Some things are worth keeping.
cutscene.CS08.01.001: Three planks and a cart that takes a slight detour. In a few decades this will be a place where people sit down.
cutscene.CS08.01.002: This is how you repair time. Bit by bit, not all at once.
cutscene.CS08.02.001: And the low wall with our hiding place has stayed standing.
cutscene.CS09.01.001: Up along the cable. A snowy forest below us, silence in the gondola.
cutscene.CS09.02.001: Priehyba. Change for the Funitel towards Chopok.
epilogue.1.line: At last, a ball he won’t swap for any other.
epilogue.1.shot: Bodka lies beside the red ball.
epilogue.2.line: See? No account needed. Large print is enough.
epilogue.2.shot: Jozef reads the large notice out to another neighbour.
epilogue.3.line: The one at the back belongs there too.
epilogue.3.shot: Soňa’s photo of the whole team hangs in the gallery.
epilogue.4.line: Some tunes are worth letting play to the end.
epilogue.4.shot: Tamara stops repairing for a moment and listens to ‘Four Stops’.
epilogue.5.shot: A reproduction of Juraj’s underpass picture hangs in the gallery. Every window is lit differently.
epilogue.6.line: Delivered. I’d have believed it without a stamp too.
epilogue.6.shot: Béla sits outside the post office window. Alojz calmly closes his book.
epilogue.7.line: Never fear, darling! This time I’ve got the second page too.
epilogue.7.shot: At rehearsal Rudo finally gets through his whole line. Lída holds back a laugh.
epilogue.8.line: The card has no delivery function. I will keep it.
epilogue.8.shot: At Tamara’s desk, Očko receives a paper card saying THANK YOU.
epilogue.9.line: It started with being allowed to explain it in my own words.
epilogue.9.shot: Three times the same gesture by Jana: at her drawing in 1982, at the laptops in 2020, at a display case in 2035.
epilogue.10.line: The last bell! And in September the first one again.
epilogue.10.shot: The end of June 1962. Zuzana rings the class bell and the first years run out for the holidays.
epilogue.11.line: The last bell. And in September the first one again.
epilogue.11.shot: The end of June 1995. Children circle the yard on their bikes, and Kubo rings loudest of all.
